The operating company and vendor directly providing the software solutions and services at **ivanti.com** (product: **Ivanti**) is **Ivanti, Inc.** (operating alongside its regional affiliated entities).

### Evidence & Provider Statements
According to the **Ivanti End User License and Services Agreement** and legal terms hosted on **ivanti.com**:
* *"All references to 'Ivanti' shall mean the entity identified below in the same geographic region as You: • Ivanti, Inc., a Delaware corporation, in the Americas, except Brazil, and in China."*
* *"Ivanti, Inc. ('Ivanti'), a Delaware corporation having its principal place of business at 10377 South Jordan Gateway, South Jordan, UT 84095..."* (Ivanti Developer Program Agreement).
